source.label: The local implication for zeta with the count on a thin shell, and explicit constants

reviewer: Claude Code proof assessment; fresh medium reviewer

claims.summary: In the two-radius zero-sum inequality: (1) the number K of zeros in |s - s0| <= R1 is at most M/log(R2/R1); (2) with K_s the number of zeros within distance e^eps d of s0, d the least distance, there is k in (m, m + K_s] with [2 (K_s/(8e(m+K_s)))^K_s - (K - K_s) e^(-eps k)] d^-k <= (E_low + E_up)/(k-1)! + 2 M' k R1^-k.
claims.assessment: Working proof: Blaschke factors give the count; the second main theorem (published; read, not audited) is applied to the shell only and the remaining zeros are bounded trivially.
claims.rationale: Narrows the zeros that must be few in the local implication to those nearly as close to the centre as the nearest one.
claims.next_action: None beyond its use in the corollary.
claims.formalization_scope: Not formalized; no Lean work assigned.

notes.mathematical_status: Complete proof in the entry, on two recorded lemmas.
notes.significance: Context: a technical refinement. Novelty not claimed.
notes.relationships: Refines the two-radius zero-sum inequality, which it gives when the shell is the whole disk.

claims.summary: For large tau0: if |sum over y < n <= y' of Lambda(n) n^(-i tau0)| <= C y tau0^-1 log^A y for all tau0^2 <= y < y' <= 2y and zeta(3/4 + i tau0) = 0, then with s0 = 4.125 + i tau0 and d <= 3.375 the least distance from s0 to a zero, more than 0.02 log tau0 zeros lie in d <= |s - s0| <= e^0.02 d, all with real part at least 0.625; the disk of radius 3.5 holds at most 19.65 log tau0 zeros.
claims.assessment: Conditional result with a complete proof and constants checked by a saved script. The premise on prime sums is unproved; the threshold height is unspecified and the count is below one zero for tau0 < e^50.
claims.rationale: States in numbers the exception of the conditional exclusion of an off-line zero of zeta from square-root cancellation of prime sums at its height.
claims.next_action: Read or derive the explicit formula to say what the premise constrains.
claims.formalization_scope: Not formalized; no Lean work assigned.

notes.mathematical_status: Conditional on the prime-sum premise at the height; explicit instance at real part 3/4.
notes.relationships: Explicit shell form of the sparse off-line exclusion.

relationships: With the shell equal to the whole disk it is that lemma; it implies it.

The corollary applies the lemma to zeta with explicit parameters.
